# Changelog

All notable changes to this plugin will be documented here.

## 1.0.0 — initial release

- Added the `openseo` MCP server pointing at OpenSEO's hosted Streamable HTTP endpoint (`https://app.openseo.so/mcp`).
- Auth uses OAuth 2.1 with PKCE and dynamic client registration. There is no API key or client ID to configure.
- Bundled OpenSEO's twelve public SEO skills from [every-app/open-seo](https://github.com/every-app/open-seo/tree/main/plugins/openseo/skills).
- Logo: OpenSEO's official mark on a 192×192 tile.
